New message in #sales:

mike: does anyone know the current MRR for Acme Corp?

input.text:
On it. Quick clarification:
- Source of truth? (Salesforce, HubSpot, Stripe, or the warehouse)
- Definition? Net MRR as of today, or end-of-last-month? Include discounts/credits?

If no preference, I’ll pull net MRR as of today from Salesforce and post back.

content.text: I posted in #sales to clarify the source of truth and MRR definition. Want me to assume Salesforce and report net MRR as of today if they don’t specify?
